exposure: Modified WHO risk classification of maternal cardiovascular diseases
outcome: Maternal complications (e.g., congestive cardiac failure, acute pulmonary edema)
cohort: 72 pregnant women with cardiac disease at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
finding: There was a statistically significant association between maternal complications (congestive cardiac failure and acute pulmonary edema) and the modified WHO risk assessment class of maternal cardiovascular diseases in pregnancy.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant association between the modified WHO risk classification of heart disease and the mode of delivery.
